class.name: WeightedChoiceTable
class.brief_description: A reusable, bounded discrete probability table with deterministic index sampling.
class.description: Configures between 1 and 4096 nonnegative, finite weights with a positive total of at most 1e12. Zero-weight outcomes are never selected. Validation is atomic: malformed weights keep the last valid table. One externally supplied draw in [code][0, 1)[/code] selects the matching weighted index in logarithmic time, without allocating per-sample arrays or advancing the global RNG. Call [code]sample_unit(rng.randf())[/code] to use a seeded [RandomNumberGenerator] so gameplay replays consume the same single draw. Relative weights determine probabilities. This Resource is not cryptographically secure, and [method sample_unit] is read-only.

method.name: configure
method.description: Atomically replaces the table. Rejects empty, all-zero, negative, nonfinite, oversized, and excessive-total inputs without changing the previous table.

method.name: sample_unit
method.description: Returns an outcome index for a finite uniform draw in [code][0, 1)[/code], or -1 if input/table is invalid. Boundary values select the next nonzero bucket.

method.name: sample_many
method.description: Maps at most 65536 valid draws to ordered indices; invalid input returns an empty array without partial sampling. Does not consume any RNG state.

method.name: sample_excluding
method.description: Samples the remaining relative weights after excluding the supplied indices. Returns -1 for invalid draws, out-of-range exclusions and exhaustion. Duplicate exclusions are allowed and zero-weight outcomes are never selected. No RNG state or table state is changed. Runs in O(option count + exclusion count).

method.name: get_probability
method.description: Returns the normalized probability for an index, or 0 for an invalid index or unconfigured table.

method.name: get_total_weight
method.description: Returns the sum of weights for the configured table.

method.name: is_configured
method.description: Returns true when a valid positive-total distribution is available.

members.member: Relative outcome weights. Setter ignores malformed input; use [method configure] for a success/failure result.
